messages:
Sam B: Hey infra team — onboarding request for a new customer (NimbleFinance). Need to provision a private env + Dedicated inference pool. Asking for quota bumps and project approvals.
Sam B: Requirements: 8x A100 (a100-40gb) in us-central1 for training/inference experiments, 16x L4 in us-west1 for low-latency inference, and 2 static external IPs for NAT/egress. Prefer dedicated projects under org billing-hostproject: redwood-cores.
Maria L: Got it. Are these for Hosted or Private? Any VPC/sharing constraints? :thinking_face:
Sam B: Private deployment (VPC-SC) with shared VPC from corp-network. Customer wants private control plane + on-prem connector later. We'll need service project enablement and sharedVPC host project IAM setup.
Kevin R: Security ask: ensure customer keys are KMS-wrapped. Also need to run a preflight checklist for subnet IP ranges and firewall rules. Who owns the host project IAM changes?
Sam B: Platform team will own host project changes but we need infra approval for quota and static IP reserve cost. Project names: nimblefi-prod and nimblefi-staging under billing host redwood-billing-prod.
infra-bot: ACTION_TEMPLATE: Please fill GCP quota request form: https://go/gcp-quota-request — include project IDs, exact accelerator types, regions, and justification. Auto-cc: infra-approvers.
Jess T: Cost check — back-of-envelope monthly cost: A100 (on-demand) x8 + L4 x16 + 2 static IPs + egress. Can someone throw a rough estimate? I want to flag to sales for pricing.
Maria L: Quick estimate: A100 cost ~ $3k-4k/month each (depends on discount). L4 ~ $1k/month each. Static IPs negligible (~$3-7/month). We'll add network egress separately. I'll post detailed numbers once quotas approved.
Sam B: For quota form, suggested numbers: request A100 quota: 8 GPUs in us-central1 (accelerator type a100), L4 quota: 16 GPUs in us-west1 (accelerator type l4), external IPv4: 2 global. Also request 'Compute Engine API' enabled on both projects.
Sam B: Example gcloud check I ran locally:
```
# check quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format="json(quotas)"
# reserve static external IP
gcloud compute addresses create nimblefi-egress-1 --region=us-west1
```
Kevin R: Also confirm if H100 is needed — current regional capacity in us-central1 is low and H100 requests may be rejected. If customer asks for H100 fallback, we should propose A100 + L4 fallback plan.
Sam B: Not requesting H100 now, noted. If capacity constraint, plan: fall back to a100-40gb in the same region or cross-region routing to us-east1.
Maria L: Approvers: @infra-approvers (maria, taylor, kevin). I'll start the org-level quota ticket and loop in network for sharedVPC peering and routes. Sam, can you paste the project IDs and billing account in the form?
Sam B: Pasted in the form and added justification (production inference for fintech workloads, SLA 99.9). Also asked for expedited review — customer has contract start 2/1.
infra-bot: TICKET_OPENED: gcp-quota-2112345678 — status: pending-review. Assigned to: Maria L.
Maria L: Thanks. I'll escalate if we don't hear back in 48h. If GCP asks, we should provide expected sustained QPS and TPU usage (none for now).
Jess T: FYI finance approved provisional spend cap to cover initial 90 days while sales finalizes commitment.
Sam B: Thanks all. I'll follow up with sharedVPC host owners and post any GCP responses here. :v:
